instructions.supplier: Which line holds the name of the company that issued this invoice?
instructions.number: Which line holds the invoice number?
instructions.date: Which line holds the invoice date?
instructions.total: Which line holds the total amount of the invoice? Pick the SHORTEST line that is just an amount, or a label plus the amount (e.g. '$200.00 USD', '$29.00', 'Total $50.00', 'Amount due $50.00'). A line that contains the word 'due' followed by a month name and a year (e.g. '$200.00 USD due July 30, 2026') is ALWAYS WRONG: never pick it.
instructions.date_order: How is the invoice date written?
instructions.currency: Which currency is the invoice total in? Judge by the currency symbol or code printed on the invoice.
instructions.category: Which expense item fits what was bought?

category_criteria.AI Models & API: AI models, AI subscriptions, inference or generation credits.
category_criteria.Developer Tools: APIs, SDKs and tools used by developers.

hints: TOTAL TRAP (Anthropic, Pinecone; happened 5 times): the line '$200.00 USD due July 30, 2026' or '$200.00 USD due June 30, 2026' makes the year 2026 the amount. Pick instead the other line that shows the same amount WITHOUT a date, e.g. '$200.00 USD', '$200.00', 'Amount due $200.00 USD', 'Total $200.00'.

A stray letter in front of the total (e.g. 'N258.42', 'D258.42') is a mis-read currency symbol, not a dollar sign. It is most likely the shekel sign (ILS). Look for other lines with a currency code before choosing USD.
'US$' before the amount means USD. A plain '$' usually means USD, except for WellyBox.
WellyBox invoices (total 258.42) are in ILS: the shekel sign gets mis-read as 'N', 'D' or '$'. Choose ILS for WellyBox unless a line clearly says USD.

enter.kind_instructions: You enter one supplier invoice into the accounting app, one action at a time. The blank form ('New Entry', 'Draft') is already open, nothing is focused. Typing only works if your immediately previous action was a click_item on that input. Order: click lower 'Supplier' -> type_supplier -> click the date line ONCE -> type_date -> click '+ Add Row' once -> then decide by the ITEM ROW at y≈472: (a) its first cell reads '× Item' or 'X Item' = item NOT entered yet: click_item on that '× Item' line; if your last action was exactly that click -> type_item. (b) the first cell shows the item name and the cell below 'Rate' reads '$ 0.00' -> click_item on it, once. (c) item name present, the cell below 'Rate' reads '0.00' without '$' and your last action was the click on it -> type_amount. (d) Grand Total equals the invoice amount -> 'Save' -> 'Yes' -> 'Submit' -> confirm. While '× Item' is visible NEVER click '$ 0.00' or '0.00' and never choose type_amount. Never choose type_amount when the last action was type_item, press_return or type_amount. Never click the same line again after it changed nothing.
enter.item_instructions: If clicking is the right move, which on-screen line should be clicked? Blank form: the LOWER 'Supplier' (x≈917 y≈213), not the label at y≈181. After Add Row, while the row shows '× Item' / 'X Item' (x≈631 y≈472, below='Item'): click THAT line, it is the item input. Do not click the column header 'Item' (643,422), and do not click '$ 0.00' or '0.00' yet. Only when the item name stands in the row: click the '$ 0.00' whose below is 'Rate' (x≈976 y≈472), not the '$ 0.00' below 'Amount' (x≈1074) and not the '$0.00' at x≈815 (Net/Grand Total). In a popup click its button (Yes / No / Okay / Submit). Never click column headers (y≈422), the sidebar, the 'Purchase Invoice' title, the top 'Create' button, calendar day numbers, a second 'Add Row', the date line once it shows the invoice date, or a line you already clicked with no effect.

kinds.click_item: Click one of the on-screen lines: a button (+ Add Row, Save, Submit, Yes, No, Okay), an input to focus it (lower 'Supplier', the date line, the row's '× Item' placeholder, the row's '$ 0.00' below 'Rate'), or a dropdown option. First action on the blank form: lower 'Supplier'. Right after '+ Add Row': the '× Item' line at y≈472. WRONG: clicking '0.00' (no '$') below Rate again, it is already focused.
kinds.type_supplier: Type the supplier name. ONLY if your immediately previous action was click_item on the lower 'Supplier' line (y≈213). WRONG as the first action, WRONG after press_return, WRONG after a type_supplier that changed nothing. Return is pressed automatically afterwards.
kinds.type_date: Type the invoice date. Choose this right after ONE click on the date line under 'Date', when the calendar popup (month name + year, day numbers, 'Clear', 'Today') is open and the line reads like '19/09/2026, 15:39:09'. The popup is closed and the date typed for you.
kinds.type_item: Type the expense item name. ONLY if your immediately previous action was click_item on the row's '× Item' / 'X Item' line (x≈631 y≈472). WRONG after clicking the header 'Item' (y≈422) or after clicking '$ 0.00' / '0.00': the item does not get entered and Return scrolls the page (invoices 45, 46, 50). Return is pressed automatically afterwards.
kinds.type_amount: Type the invoice amount. ONLY if the item name already stands in the row (no '× Item' on screen) AND your immediately previous action was click_item on the row's cell below 'Rate' (it now reads '0.00' without '$', x≈981 y≈472). WRONG if your previous action was type_item, press_return or type_amount. Never twice in a row.
kinds.press_return: Press Return to confirm the highlighted dropdown option, only if a dropdown with the typed value is still open and the value is not yet in the field. Not needed after type_supplier/type_item: it is pressed for you.
kinds.press_tab: Press Tab to leave a field after its value is visibly on screen. Do not use Tab to find fields.
kinds.press_escape: Press Escape to close a menu that is blocking the form. Do NOT use it on the date calendar before type_date, and do not use it on Yes/No or Okay popups: click their button instead.
kinds.scroll_down: Scroll down, only if a needed button or field is not among the screen lines.
kinds.scroll_up: Scroll up when the form is scrolled down: the lines 'Number Series', 'Supplier', 'Date' are missing and 'Add Row' stands near y≈203 with 'Net Total' at y≈253. Then continue with the item row.
kinds.wait: The screen is still changing; wait.
kinds.done: Only when the invoice was saved AND submitted: the form no longer shows 'Draft' or 'New Entry' and shows the supplier and the correct Grand Total. Never while Grand Total is $0.00 or a popup is open.

hints: STEP 1: the blank form ('New Entry', 'Draft') is open and NO field is focused. First action = click_item on the LOWER 'Supplier' line (x≈917 y≈213; the label at y≈181 does nothing). Only then type_supplier. If you see a list screen instead, click 'Make Entry'.
TRAP: type_supplier as the first action types into nothing (screen_changed=False, placeholder 'Supplier' stays at y≈213). If that happened, click the lower 'Supplier' line now, then type_supplier.

After type_supplier the engine presses Return itself. The supplier is entered when its name stands at y≈213 and Account shows 'Creditors'. A leftover dropdown (name + 'Create' at y≈262-295) closes with your next click. Do not retype, do not click 'Create'.

DATE: click the date line under 'Date' ONCE (reads 'Sep 19, 2026 ...', x≈957 y≈290). A calendar opens and the line becomes '19/09/2026, ...'. The very next action MUST be type_date (the engine closes the calendar and types). Nothing in between.
The date is entered when the line reads like '26/06/2026, ...' or 'Jun 26, 2026 ...' matching the invoice date. Then NEVER click the date line again: it only reopens the calendar.

After the date, click '+ Add Row' (x≈641 y≈473) exactly ONCE. A row appears at y≈472 reading '× Item', 'Tax', '1', '$ 0.00', '$ 0.00' and '+ Add Row' moves down to y≈520. A second Add Row creates an empty Row 2 and every save fails.

ITEM FIRST: right after Add Row click the line '× Item' (OCR may read 'X Item'; x≈631 y≈472, below='Item'). That is the row's item input. NOT the header 'Item' at 643,422 and NOT '$ 0.00'. A dropdown with the item names opens; then type_item.
RULE: while a line '× Item' / 'X Item' is on screen, the item is NOT entered. The only right moves are: click '× Item', then type_item. Everything about Rate and amount comes later.

TRAP (invoices 42-50, 8 of 8 died): Jev clicked '$ 0.00' below 'Rate' while the row still showed '× Item', then clicked the '0.00' 4-7 more times with no effect. Do not touch the Rate cell before the item name is in the row.

TRAP (invoices 45, 46, 50): click on the header 'Item' (643,422) then type_item: the item was NOT entered ('× Item' stayed in the row) and Return scrolled the page. type_item only after a click on '× Item'.

After type_item + Return the item name replaces '× Item' in the row at y≈472 (OCR reads 'Al Models & API' for 'AI Models & API'); a small dropdown (same name, 'Create') may stay open below. The cursor is STILL in the Item cell. Do not type now.

NEXT after the item name appears: click_item ONCE on the '$ 0.00' whose below is 'Rate' (x≈976 y≈472). The cell turns into '0.00' without '$' (x≈981): that means it is focused. Next action = type_amount. Do NOT click '0.00' again.

Rate and Amount cells both read '$ 0.00' at y≈472: Rate is x≈976 with below='Rate', Amount is x≈1074 with below='Amount' (do not click). The '$0.00' at x≈815 belongs to Net/Grand Total: never click it.

TRAP: type_amount right after type_item/press_return writes the digits into the Item cell ('SaaS Subscription4', 'Cloud & Hosting25.'). Grand Total stays $0.00 and the save fails. Always click the Rate cell in between.
Never choose type_amount twice in a row. If Grand Total is still $0.00 after type_amount, click the row's cell below 'Rate' once, then type_amount once.
After type_amount the engine presses Tab. Success looks like: the row's Rate and Amount cells, Net Total and Grand Total (x≈815) all showing the invoice amount.
Click 'Save' (x≈1302 y≈67) only when the row's item name is CLEAN (no digits glued to it, no '× Item') and Grand Total shows the invoice amount.

Save opens a popup 'Save New Purchase Invoice NN?' / 'Create new Purchase Invoice entry?' with 'Yes' and 'No'. If it is plain, click 'Yes'. If it also says 'Entry has Grand Total $0.00. Please verify amounts', click 'No' and go fix the Rate.

Popup 'Not Found - Item value <name><digits> does not exist': click 'Okay'. The Item cell is corrupted. Do NOT click Save again. Repair: click the corrupted name in the row, click the clean item name in the dropdown below, then Rate cell, then type_amount.
Popup 'Mandatory Error - Value missing for Items Row 2': click 'Okay'; an empty second row exists (y≈520, with an '×' at its left). Try clicking that '×' to remove it. Never click 'Add Row' again.

After a successful Save the 'Draft'/'New Entry' state changes and a 'Submit' button should appear at the top right: click it, and if a confirmation popup appears, click its confirming button (Yes / Submit). Saving alone leaves a Draft, which does not count.

SCROLLED FORM: if 'Number Series', 'Supplier' and 'Date' are missing and you see 'Add Row' near y≈203, 'Net Total' y≈253, 'References', 'Notes', the form is scrolled down. Choose scroll_up. Do not click '$0.00' at 815,285 (3 useless clicks in invoices 45, 46, 50).

Never click the 'Purchase Invoice' title, the top 'Create' button (x≈1227 y≈67), or sidebar lines (Dashboard, Sales, Purchases, Suppliers, Purchase Items, Common, Reports, Setup). In popups click the button line; after 'Okay' on an error, FIX it before the next Save.

If your last action shows screen_changed=False, or you already clicked the same line twice, choose something DIFFERENT: after a type_* that changed nothing, click the field; after a useless click, a different line or the matching type_* action.
Do not use press_tab to hunt for fields: focus is invisible and values typed that way never landed. Click the field you want.
